description: Ministry of Industry & Commerce - Authorize the purpose of Sri Lankan Society of Criminology as a purpose to which the powers & facilities aught to be extended
reasoning: This gazette notification exercises powers under the Societies Ordinance (Chapter 123) to authorize a society's purpose and grant exemptions from specific provisions of the ordinance. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters - specifically the application and modification of existing legislation - rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories. The mention of the minister's name and title is incidental to the legal authority being exercised, not the primary focus of the notification.
